name: SURBL (multi.surbl.org)
tier_rationale: Long-running domain reputation list with public documentation and usage policy (A8 community).

reliability.justification: Domain reputation of message-body URIs (phishing, malware, abuse, cracked sites) with documented bitmask codes.

multi.title: SURBL multi (domain zone, bitmask answers; registered resolvers or data feed only)

terms.quote: P045 cond 2 (binding council text): URIBL, SURBL, UCEPROTECT and Barracuda are noncommercial/fair-use lists: off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared (their free-use terms recorded and allowed by legal).

multi.notes: Quote: binding council text (P045 cond 2). Refuses public resolvers ('No Reachable Authority' through Cloudflare, 2026-11-25): never queried through public DoH (P045 cond 4). Domain zone: domains only (P045 cond 9). Used by dnsbl.
multi.licensed_alternative: A licence_allow entry recording SURBL's terms plus a registered resolver or data feed.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G02-2 (P045). DNS only: the list is queried through DNS A lookups (core DoH layer or the system resolver), never over HTTP, so the provider has no HTTP host. Every DNSBL counts as ONE 'spam' family vote in P171 consensus (upstream_family 'dnsbl', P045 cond 8).
